instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-13_input.step. In the 160 x 90 x 14 mm plate, create six vertical through holes. The holes at (30,25), (130,25), (30,65), and (130,65) are diameter 6 mm; the holes at (80,25) and (80,65) are diameter 8 mm. The two left holes at X=30 have top counterbores of diameter 16 mm and depth 5 mm. The two right holes at X=130 have bottom counterbores of diameter 14 mm and depth 4 mm. The two center holes at X=80 remain ordinary through holes without counterbores. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-13_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). For the steps below, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-13_input.step`.
